basic_info.description: Welcome to this charming single-family home that perfectly blends comfort, functionality, and convenience! The inviting upper level boasts a thoughtfully designed layout with 2 spacious bedrooms, 1 bathroom, a bright living room, a formal dining area, and a well-appointed kitchen. Step through the elegant French doors and discover your own private backyard oasisideal for relaxing, entertaining, or creating the garden of your dreams. The expansive lower level [approx 757 sqft +- bonus space] offers incredible versatility with a sleeping area, dedicated office space, and a large entertaining zone, giving you endless possibilities to adapt the home to your lifestyle. Convenience is key with features such as central heating, a clean garage with a brand-new door and motor, and an upstairs laundry area for everyday ease. All of this is nestled in an unbeatable location with quick access to Hwy 101 and 280, public transportation options including Muni and BART, and an array of local shops and restaurants just moments away. This home truly checks all the boxes for modern living in the heart of the Bay Area!
